primary_sources.title: Deep Spoken Keyword Spotting: An Overview
primary_sources.use: Compact spectral frontends, acoustic/posterior stages, explicit rejection and full-system cost evaluation. No claim isolated KWS proves complete commands.

primary_sources.title: Low resource end-to-end spoken language understanding with capsule networks
primary_sources.use: Direct audio-to-semantic labels and user demonstrations support the pure-VCM task formulation. Capsule routing is not adopted; no demonstrated need here.

primary_sources.title: LIS-Net: An end-to-end light interior search network for speech command recognition
primary_sources.use: Small-footprint convolutional designs are viable; keep the existing compact CNN. Google Speech Commands scores are not complete smart-home-command evidence.

primary_sources.title: Feature learning for efficient ASR-free keyword spotting in low-resource languages
primary_sources.use: Target-domain acoustics and learned representations matter for query-by-example. Do not add DTW/BNF/CAE machinery to this prototype; published retrieval scores do not validate our playlists.

primary_sources.title: Rethinking End-to-End Evaluation of Decomposable Tasks: A Case Study on Spoken Language Understanding
primary_sources.use: Motivates separating acoustic/semantic generalization and reporting source/speaker/phrase evidence; conference, not journal.

primary_sources.title: Few-Shot Keyword Spotting in Any Language
primary_sources.use: Spoken enrollment needs explicit unknown/background evaluation. Do not transfer isolated-keyword results to full playlist commands or import its pretrained pipeline.

decision: No architecture expansion; two matched data/sampling arms, separate development and test, bounded CPU-only release.
